'''2006 Tennessee DPC''' was a Star Wars CCG constructed tournament in Tennessee (10 June 2006). It is known from the decklists below, recovered from DeckTech posts and Players Committee forms. [[Brian Rippetoe]] and [[Brandon Ruck]] qualified at the event for the [[2006 World Championship]].<ref name="pcf-9443-141025">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141025#141025 Qualifiers for Worlds 2006], Brandon Ruck (newhorizans), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (13 June 2006). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618055549/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=141112 Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Tennessee
* '''Dates:''' 10 June 2006
